metadata.title: Hypervelocity stars and the environment of Sgr A*

notes: No individual star is identifiable from the supplied material. The paper models generic HVS populations and refers only collectively to samples, e.g. “5 stars with v_RF > +400 km s−1 and r > 50 kpc (the unbound genuine HVSs of Brown et al. 2006a)” and “7 candidate HVSs” (T:p4-b3). Figure 5 mentions HVSs from Hirsch et al. (2005) and Edelmann et al. (2005) but gives no names, catalogue numbers, or source IDs, and its points are unlabeled (I:p5-b0). Group statements therefore cannot support one roster entry per distinct star. Sgr A* is the central massive black hole, not a star.
